Package com.sbancuz.offscreen

@ParametersAreNonnullByDefault package com.sbancuz.offscreen
OffscreenCleanroom mod initialization and sided startup.

This port retains the upstream com.sbancuz.offscreen API namespace while using the mod ID offscreencleanroom. Client-specific registration lives in the client proxy so dedicated-server startup does not eagerly load Minecraft rendering classes or native windows.
